ownership: One closure and Map per explicit filtered scan; capacity bounded by distinct non-exact header cwd strings. Query native identity is lazy and at most once per scan. No retained global cache or pool.
callChain: Explicit list/continue/recent discovery and default-directory classification. usesDefaultSessionDir is consumed by selector scope loading and exit resume-command formatting, not render. No changes to append, deltas, progress callbacks or frame generation.
existingCosts: File/header reading, discovery arrays and wrappers, sorting and list promises remain. This low-frequency change does not claim zero allocation or general timing improvement; counts describe API calls, not OS syscalls.
compatibility: Historical default bucket names unchanged. Explicit bucket aliases preserve unfiltered default discovery; empty in-memory directory sentinel remains non-default. Missing cwd uses exact lexical identity; empty/non-string/malformed headers do not match a custom project filter.
platformCoverage: Local Windows case/drive/namespace/junction and real case-sensitive directories. POSIX symlink counterpart runs in Node 26 CI. Remote UNC not exercised.
